verdict.rationale: Sill's own docs and README say touch and Apple Pencil on iPhone or iPad drive the Mac. Taps become clicks, scrolls carry momentum, the Pencil acts as the pointer, and three-finger swipes and pinches map to Mac trackpad gestures. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of how accurate the touch and stylus pointer mapping is.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host

citations.quote: lets you use it with touch, a keyboard or Apple Pencil
taps and clicks, scrolls with momentum, the on-screen trackpad, keys and typed text, and Apple Pencil as the pointer.
Three fingers swipe and pinch as on a Mac's trackpad
